metrics.note: Classification metrics use successful responses only; failures are separate. Abstentions retain any accepted labels and count normally. Null means undefined, not zero. Macro averages exclude undefined class ratios. Urgency labels are subjective author expectations, not safety ground truth.

billing_note: Estimate from returned input tokens and published price; failed-call usage may be unknown. Not an invoice.
